description_en: Queries the risk list of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka get-risk-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-pe335pgxxxxx --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRiskList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 分页参数，起始索引大小
parameters.name: start_index

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

RiskList.description_en: The list of instance risk items

GradeType.description_en:
The metric rating. Valid values:
A: Healthy.
B: Sub-healthy.
F: Poor
GradeType.description_zh:
指标评级。返回值有三种：
A：健康。
B：亚健康。
F：差

Health.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is healthy. Valid values:
true: Healthy.
false: Unhealthy
Health.description_zh:
是否健康。
布尔类型，返回值为：
true：表示健康
false：表示不健康

LastAlarmTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last alert. Unit: milliseconds
LastAlarmTime.description_zh: 上次告警时间戳。单位：毫秒

LevelType.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:

0: Critical.
1: Important.
2: Normal
LevelType.description_zh:
风险级别。返回值有三种：

0：紧急。
1：重要。
2：一般

Name.description_en:
The name of the risk item.

There are 24 types of names.
Detailed descriptions are provided in the following sections
Name.description_zh:
风险项名称。

名称有 24 种。
文档下面有详细的补充说明

Owner.description_en: The ID of the user who owns the instance

RelationList.description_en: The infinitely nested structure. The system determines whether to nest another layer of report data based on the outer-layer fields
RelationList.description_zh: 无限级联结构，内部会根据外层字段判断是否再嵌套一层报告数据

ReportTips.example: 相关问题里的Topic存在碎片化发送问题，请参考文档进行优化

ReportType.description_en:
The report type of the risk item. Valid values:

topic: a specific topic that requires optimization.
group: a specific group that requires optimization.
doc: optimization is required based on the documentation.
commonBuy: the returned risk item requires operations such as specification upgrade.
mdsKey: follow the suggestions in ReportTips to fix the issue
ReportType.description_zh:
风险项的报告类型。返回值：

topic：具体到某个 Topic 需要进行优化。
group：具体到某个 Group 需要进行优化。
doc：表示需要按照文档进行优化。
commonBuy: 表示返回的风险项，需要进行升配等操作。
mdsKey：只需按照 ReportTips 中的建议进行修复即可

ReportValue.description_en:
The value of the report.


If ReportType is set to doc, ReportValue returns a document address. You can construct the link by replacing the returned ReportValue in the following URL: <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props>
If ReportType is set to commonBuy, operations such as specification upgrade are required.
If ReportType is set to topic, check the value of reportValue. The reportValue is the topic that has issues and requires fixing.
If ReportType is set to group, check the value of reportValue. The reportValue is the group that has issues and requires fixing.
If ReportType is set to mdsKey, follow the suggestions in ReportTips to fix the issue
ReportValue.description_zh:
报告的值。


当 ReportType 为 doc 时，ReportValue 返回的是文档地址。用户可根据返回的值进行组装进行链接跳转，将返回的 ReportValue 的值替换即可访问文档地址： <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props>
当 ReportType 为 commonBuy 时。表示需要进行升配等操作。
当 ReportType 为 topic 时，关注 reportValue 中的值，reportValue 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Topic。
当 ReportType 为 group 时，关注 reportValue 中的值，reportValue 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Group。
当 ReportType 为 mdsKey 时，只需按照 ReportTips 中的建议进行修复即可

Status.description_en:
The status of the risk item, which indicates whether the risk item has been fixed. Valid values:

0: Pending fix.
-1: Ignored.
1: Fixed
Status.description_zh:
风险项状态。表示是否修复该风险项。返回值有三种：

0：表示待修复。
-1：表示已忽略。
1：表示已修复

Type.description_en:
The type of the risk item.
There are 24 types of risk items.
Detailed descriptions are provided in the following sections
Type.description_zh:
风险项类型。
风险项类型有 24 种。
文档下面有详细的补充说明

Value.description_en:
The value calculated by the system.

If ReportType is set to doc, check both the relationList field and the value field. The value field returns a number that indicates how many topics or groups in the relationList field require optimization.
If ReportType is set to commonBuy, compare the Value. The Value returns a percentage.
If ReportType is set to topic, check the Value. The value is the topic that has issues and requires fixing.
If ReportType is set to group, check the Value. The value is the group that has issues and requires fixing
Value.description_zh:
系统计算出的值。

当 ReportType 为 doc 时。需要同时看 relationList  字段和 value 字段，value 字段会给返回一个数量，表示 relationList  字段中，有多少个 Topic 或 Group 需要优化。
当 ReportType 为 commonBuy 时。需要关注对比 Value 的值，Value 会给返回一个百分比的数值。
当 ReportType 为 topic 时，关注 Value 中的值，value 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Topic。
当 ReportType 为 group 时，关注 Value 中的值，value 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Group

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
